review_scope: Findings below the minimum independent-source threshold

extreme_value_cases.note: No separate extreme-value assessment was performed.

missing_group_effects.note: No separate missing-group impact assessment was performed.

ranking_stability.note: 12 of 16 overall comparison ranks changed after removing one source observation. This indicates sensitivity in the tested scenario, not a comprehensive stability test.

test_design.selection_rule: Remove the individual source observation with the largest absolute Actual minus Budget variance.
test_design.removal_unit: One complete source observation containing four financial measures.
test_design.analytical_method: The existing approved load_and_pair and build_comparisons functions were used without modification.

sensitivity_review.interpretation: This is a descriptive sensitivity assessment of the effect of removing one large source observation. Changes in variance, ranking or evidence status indicate sensitivity to that observation. Unchanged findings do not establish statistical robustness or population-level validity.
limitations: The dataset contains synthetic source observations.
Only one removal scenario was tested.
This test does not establish statistical significance or population-level robustness.
Groups falling below the minimum source threshold become insufficient_evidence and are excluded from ranking.
Ranking changes can result from changed variances, evidence eligibility or the ordering of remaining groups.

excluded_cases.reason: Monthly findings below the minimum independent-source threshold are not eligible for overall ranking.

review_conclusion: Monthly findings with fewer than three independent source observations remain descriptive, are not ranked, and must not be interpreted as sufficiently supported overall comparisons.
interpretation: The 48 monthly findings are descriptive only. Their limited source counts do not support population-level conclusions.

limitation: Monthly subgroup results are descriptive and are not overall rankings.
